name: Free Will
overview: Scripture clearly presents that God has granted mankind the freedom to make choices, exemplified in His command to Adam to freely eat from the garden trees and His call to Israel to choose life or death (Genesis 2:16; Deuteronomy 30:19). This freedom includes the responsibility to decide whom to serve, as Joshua challenges his people to choose between idols and the LORD (Joshua 24:15). While man plans his way, the LORD ultimately directs his steps, showing divine sovereignty working alongside human will (Proverbs 16:9). Furthermore, those who receive Christ are given the right to become children of God, highlighting the power of belief in exercising free will in faith (John 1:12; John 7:17).
